KEANO Retro Princess Style Kids' Girls Bike - Sizes 12" to 20"
Let your child ride into their next adventure with the charm and elegance of the KEANO Retro Princess Style Kids' Bike. Merging a breathtaking vintage aesthetic with cutting-edge comfort and safety, this single-speed bicycle is meticulously engineered to build confidence, support growing riders, and create unforgettable childhood memories.

Charming retro elegance: The KEANO Girls Bike featuring a classic vintage silhouette, custom basket, and premium finishes.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted for ultimate peace of mind, combining an ultra-smooth single-speed drivetrain with an intuitive dual-brake system that gives young riders absolute control."
Dual-Brake Safety System & Stability
Safety is built into every detail. The KEANO Princess bike delivers maximum stopping power through an advanced dual-brake configuration, uniting a responsive front hand caliper brake with a reliable rear coaster (foot) brake. To handle rugged neighborhood sidewalks and park trails, the bike is fitted with wide 2.125" pneumatic tires wrapped around heavy-duty steel rims, providing a rock-solid, stable foundation.

Engineered with a safety-first dual-brake layout for precise and confident stopping power on any path.

Child-Friendly Ergonomics & Comfort

Custom Brake Levers: Specially designed for small hands to pull effortlessly and efficiently.

Sealed Bearings: Upgraded bottom bracket bearings ensure a significantly smoother, low-friction glide while pedaling.

Fully Enclosed Chain Guard: Keeps moving parts away from legs, keeping clothes perfectly clean during messy outdoor play.

Growth Over Time: Features an extra-wide, ultra-soft rear saddle and quick-adjust handlebars to perfectly match your child's height as they grow.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
To guarantee the perfect fit, match your child's measurements to our guide below. Both the saddle and handlebar height can be adjusted to support your child as they grow.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We respect your time. Every KEANO bike arrives at your doorstep 85% pre-assembled. All essential assembly tools and custom-fused hardware are safely packed in the box, making the final setup quick and seamless.

<>
Watch: Walk through our simple step-by-step unboxing and assembly video to hit the road in minutes.

See It In Action
Witness how beautifully the KEANO Princess style bike glides, turns, and lights up a kid's face with independent riding joy.

Watch the KEANO Retro Princess in motion: Smooth handling, durable tracking, and timeless style.

Our Guarantee
We build our bikes to survive every neighborhood adventure. Your investment is fully backed by our ironclad manufacturer protections:

Limited Lifetime Structural Warranty covering the heavy-duty steel frame and front forks for lasting peace of mind.

Flexible Return & Replacement Windows backed by premium customer assistance to ensure you get the absolute perfect fit.

100% Authentic

Secure Ordering

Lifetime Frame Warranty

Risk-Free Policy
